title: LATAM Reserved Capacity: phased rollout, pricing windows & GTM runbook
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Launch reserved instance reservations and new instance SKUs for LATAM regions (sa-east-1 / brazil) with a phased availability window, coordinated pricing tiers, and an integrated GTM runbook. Scope includes product config, billing integrations, quota/enforcement, console UI copy, regional capacity commitments, support runbooks, and release notes. Out of scope: on-prem private packages and enterprise-only custom pricing (handled by sales ops).

Key decisions to make: pricing tiers (standard vs. discounted commit windows), SKU family mapping for parity with US/EU, whether to soft-launch with capacity caveats, and the timing of reservation billing cycles to align with existing invoice periods.

Risks: capacity shortfall during initial weeks, tax/compliance differences in LATAM billing, unclear SKU names causing support churn, and delayed kernel/runtime tuning for local instance flavors. Mitigations: coordinate with infra to reserve buffer capacity, include VAT/local tax notes on pricing pages, create SKU migration aliasing in console, and run pre-launch load tests for representative customers.

Acceptance criteria: reservations able to be purchased in console and API, billing invoices reflect correct local tax and currency, monitoring shows stable SLOs post-launch, release notes published and linked from console, sales enablement materials shared, and support playbook available in Drive.
checklist: Finalize LATAM SKU catalog and naming convention
Confirm instance availability windows with infra (sa-east-1 pool sizes)
Set reservation pricing tiers and commit durations (monthly/annual)
Update console UI copy and purchase flow with currency & tax hints
Implement quota enforcement and admin overrides for initial customers
Prepare billing integration tests with finance team (VAT/CST checks)
Complete support playbook and escalation matrix
Draft release notes and schedule publication cadence
Coordinate sales enablement webinar and partner one-pager
Run a closed beta with 3 pilot customers and collect feedback
acceptance_criteria: Reservations purchasable via API and console in sa-east-1
Invoices show localized tax and currency correctly for pilot customers
Monitoring dashboards (Console/Datadog) display capacity usage and token latency by region
No critical production incidents during 72 hours after GA for pilot cohort
Release notes published and linked in Console release banner
Sales and support collateral published to Drive and shared with GTM teams
go_to_market_tasks: Create pricing FAQ and local tax notes (Legal + Finance) - owner: Legal Ops
Schedule sales enablement session for LATAM reps - owner: Sales Ops
Prepare two email templates for pilot invite and GA announcement - owner: Growth
Localize console copy for Portuguese (pt-BR) - owner: i18n
Coordinate marketplace listing updates for cloud partners - owner: Partnerships
